title: Chemical and environmental fitness
description: 48 mutant strains × 21 chemical/environmental conditions from the complete published 3,979 × 324 drug-gene score matrix. Includes study-highlighted LPS, NADH dehydrogenase, disulfide-bond, and multiple-resistance genes plus high-variance strains.
reference: K-12 mutant collections; exact ECK strain identifiers preserved; no genome coordinate alignment
processing: Read published Table S2 workbook (XLSX bytes served under .xls name). Select up to first two columns per listed condition prefix; preserve their original labels and values. Require measured values in the first two selected conditions, retain exact-name study-highlighted genes, then fill to 48 by variance across selected conditions. Pearson network correlations use all 324 source conditions, pairwise complete observations (minimum 250); keep |r|≥0.65. No imputed scores or genomic positions.

limits: Negative growth scores denote increased sensitivity; positive scores denote increased resistance in the published assay.
Scores are not raw growth rates, survival percentages, or correlation coefficients.
Network edges are computed profile similarity, not proven molecular interactions.
Missing table entries remain null; do not color as zero.
Concentrations and UNSPECIFIED text are preserved in original source column labels.
